pms.thesis: The AUDNZD short was a breakdown continuation. The cross is still lower on the tape, but it sits at range position 0.07 after a failed 20-day breakdown, and the 11 November spot at 1.2285 is back through the 1.2266 book mark. From this floor the continuation is spent, and a rejection back into the range is the move that hurts a 300 million short, so the position comes off in full. December SOFR at 4.295 against cash SOFR at 3.88 shows the hike is already in the front end and does not clear a fresh pay or a chased dollar add.

positions.invalidation: Thesis fails if BoC hikes or the 1m CORRA strip through Dec-2026 reprices toward the 2027 CRA mid-3s; if CPI-trim/median leave the 1.9/2.0 zone higher while employment stops contracting and wages re-accelerate; or if CORRA_2027-03 implied holds at or above the 3.13 entry because catch-up is actually being delivered. A US-only or energy-headline move that leaves CRAH27 unchanged is not…
positions.thesis: That is the first 2027 three-month contract that prices a Canadian hiking cycle (+84bp vs CORRA cash 2.29) after 1m CORRA still only reaches 2.58 by Dec-2026 and Dec-26 3m CRAZ26 is 2.775. August labor (-42k, wages +2.0%) and CPI-trim/median 1.9/2.0 do not support delivering that 2027 path. Side long is duration-long in implied-rate space (profits if the 3.13 implied falls toward the still-alive near-term path).

pms.thesis: Hot October CPI leaves December 2026 SOFR implied at 4.295 and March 2027 at 4.53, so the US tightening is priced, while the CORRA March 2027 receive at 2.965 is ahead of the 3.13 entry and remains the clean Canada-versus-US gap. AUDNZD at 1.2285 sits at range position 0.07 after a failed breakdown, and that short residual is finished. Cover the cross and keep the receive. A new pay in SOFR, the US 10-year, or AONIA does not improve the book.

pms.mandate: Preservation and consistency first. Smaller sizes, high hurdles, quick de-risking. No-trade is valid.
pms.thesis: December 2026 SOFR at 4.295 already sits well above the 3.88 official fix, with March 2027 at 4.53 and September 2027 at 4.655, so the hike path from a public CPI print is in the strip. Euro at 1.1127 and dollar-yen at 159.23 are that same dollar bid after the breaks. AUDNZD at 1.2285 is a failed floor after the short from 1.25 was already closed at 1.23, so the cross is no longer an extreme. None of the new expressions clears the funding hurdle.
